articles.title: Rivian Adventure Network Adds 10 Sites, 112 Stalls: Q3 2026 Report
articles.summary: Rivian's fast-charging network grew to 165 sites and 1,185 stalls in Q3, and nearly 98% of its sites are now open to non-Rivian EVs, with NACS plugs at about 59% of locations. For drivers who rely on public fast charging, that's another large, highly rated network they can use without owning a Rivian.

articles.title: ARENA backs Alchemy Charge with $2 million to unlock home EV charging for apartment residents
articles.summary: Australia's renewable energy agency is co-funding a $7.4 million national Strata Assist program to tackle the approval, installation, and cost hurdles that stall apartment charging projects. Its digital platform, due February 2027, gives residents, landlords, and strata managers one shared path to quotes and approvals.

articles.title: Tesla Supercharger Prices Are Up 15% in the Last Year
articles.summary: Non-member Supercharging in the US now averages about $0.569/kWh, up 15% in a year, while members pay Tesla-owner rates averaging about $0.396/kWh. Drivers without home charging who Supercharge often should check whether a membership pays for itself.

articles.title: Making regional EV charging easier with pole-mounted chargers
articles.summary: Five EV chargers have been mounted on existing utility poles across Wagga Wagga's CBD in an ARENA-funded kerbside charging trial with EVX and Essential Energy. Reusing poles already on the street is a fast, low-cost way to give drivers without driveways a place to plug in.

articles.title: Expanding electric vehicle charging access for tenants and leaseholders
articles.summary: The UK government opened a consultation on an 'ability to charge' that would require landlords and freeholders to give tenants and leaseholders timely permission to install charge points at their off-street spaces. It's a step toward right-to-charge protections for renters and flat owners, alongside existing grants of up to £500.

articles.title: A parking giant with 5,700 sites is taking on apartment EV charging
articles.summary: LAZ Parking and EverCharge launched a multifamily charging service that shares a building's existing power across cars, supporting up to five times as many ports without a costly electrical upgrade. That removes one of the biggest reasons apartment and condo buildings say no to resident chargers.
